claims.text: The Tashkent account describes a Kokand-appointed bek, Russian capture and later governor-general headquarters. The Kazakh portal distinguishes Verny’s fort on an earlier Almaty site from later city status. These are different institutional changes, not one empty-site foundation or identical administration; working accounts do not establish all local powers.

recall.question: Why cannot Verny’s fort date stand for Tashkent’s governing change?
options: Verny’s fort and city status differ from Tashkent’s offices, capture and headquarters.
Both cities received an identical governor’s office when Verny’s fort was founded.
